blocks.text:
Day 3 · Morning · The Arenal Hanging Bridges at Mistico Park, one of the best nature walks around La Fortuna: about 3 km of easy trails and 15 bridges, 6 of them hanging, bring you close to the birds, flowers and lush vegetation of the primary rainforest, with views of Arenal Volcano (about 2.5 hours).

Afternoon · A guided walk on the 1968 trail, along the edge of Arenal Volcano National Park, where parts of the landscape were devastated by the lava flows of 1968 and still have little vegetation: magnificent views of the volcano, Lake Arenal and the dormant volcano Cerro Chato, with forested sections where your guide will look for birds, monkeys and other wildlife. Overnight at Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa.
